name: settlement wavelength
domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 沉降空间几何变化的特征波长。
usage_overview: 在基础沉降引起的无砟轨道变形分析中，用作控制沉降曲线纵向尺度的几何参数，以考察不同沉降尺度对轨道弯曲和板底分离的影响。

complete_examples.text: The mean interfacial damage reaches 0.5748 once the settlement wavelength is 20 m and the amplitude is 80 mm.
It can be seen that the car body acceleration does not increase regularly as the settlement wavelength decreases.
When the foundation settlement wavelength exceeds 80 m, separation seam repair is not required.
When the foundation settlement wavelength is less than 40 m, inspection and repair should be carried out regardless of the magnitude.
